from.place: Theorem lemma-theorem construction, use of the Baer criterion for injectivity

title: Baer criterion using a generator
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with generator $U$. An object $I$ of $\mathcal A$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions] if and only if for every subobject $M\subset U$, every morphism $M\to I$ extends along $M\hookrightarrow U$ to a morphism $U\to I$.
